sourceRefs.locator: “What is Jikji?” Two volumes, only the second extant from the 1377 edition, and the 1378 woodblock edition.
Section “The oldest movable metal type book” and captioned examples of tilted 人 and missing 動. Baegun, Seokchan, Daljam, Myodeok and the Heungdeoksa printing.

labels.de: Myodeok hilft, das Jikji zu drucken
labels.en: Myodeok helps pay for the printing of Jikji

note.de: Im Kloster Heungdeoksa erscheint eine Sammlung buddhistischer Lehrworte mit beweglichen Metalllettern. Der erhaltene zweite Band nennt die Nonne Myodeok unter den Beteiligten.
note.en: A collection of Buddhist teachings is printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa. The surviving second volume names the nun Myodeok among the contributors.
